_doc: Gaia declared source-locator registry (DATA, not code). The audit spine of the signal model: every direct signal Gaia may project is DECLARED here with {id, seat, group, kind, locator, capture_hint} and DELIBERATELY NO value/raw/sha256/captured_at — those are captured LIVE by collectors.cjs and stamped per Signal. Declared-vs-captured drift (a declared id never captured, or a captured id never declared) is itself auditable against this file. GAIA LAW: this registry names WHERE a raw signal lives; it NEVER stores a summarized/scored/interpreted value. NO IP LITERALS: probe locators name a viewer/infra_registry.json service id (resolved live via ${name}.${zone} by infra.cjs), never a hardcoded address.
